first.description: The button that goes to the first page.

previous.description: The button that goes to the previous page.

next.description: The button that goes to the next page.

last.description: The button that goes to the last page.

info.description: The summary beside the pager: the current page, the page count, and the total number of rows.

size.description: An option of the page size select; the size is the number of rows per page.
